## ✨ Highlights

The rest of the 2026-11-05 security review. The review that gave v2026.11.05 its two high and nine medium fixes also turned up a tail of lower-severity findings - across the nodes, the Controller and the janusctl plugin. All twelve are fixed here, and the review report is now complete.

- 🛡️ **Nothing a reader, a stranger on the network, or a scoped admin could still reach**: a crafted ICMP packet can't crash a probe, a reader can't read secrets through logs or gaps in the config masking, a write-only secret can't follow a changed URL or TLS trust to a server of the admin's choice, and the pairing or rescue window can't be shut - nor its audit flooded - by anyone who reaches it.
- 🔐 **Secrets at rest and accounts are tighter**: the Controller seals the hypervisor SSH key and Proxmox token on disk, and a deleted, disabled or demoted account's sessions and tokens end at once.
- 🧰 **The build and the plugin are sturdier**: a release can only be cut from `main`, and the janusctl plugin sees a command built from a variable and rates the traffic-moving commands as the critical ones they are.

Everything is applied by the update; there is nothing new to configure.

## ⚠️ Upgrade notes

- Nothing to do: every fix is applied by the update. **Update the janusctl Claude Code plugin** (`/plugin`) to pick up the hook's new rules ([JANUS-2026-025](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/blob/v2026.11.05-2/security/fixes/JANUS-2026-025.json)).

## 🔒 Security

Janus's own code, the tail of the 2026-11-05 security review (the report that ships with the fixes is now complete):

- **Janus itself** (nodes), its own code:
  - 🟡 medium [JANUS-2026-029](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/blob/v2026.11.05-2/security/fixes/JANUS-2026-029.json) - Anyone reaching the pairing or rescue window could close it and flood the audit
  - 🔵 low [JANUS-2026-019](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/blob/v2026.11.05-2/security/fixes/JANUS-2026-019.json) - A crafted ICMP packet could crash janusd while an operator ran a ping or traceroute probe
  - 🔵 low [JANUS-2026-023](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/blob/v2026.11.05-2/security/fixes/JANUS-2026-023.json) - A reader could read secrets through logs, the probe event and gaps in the config masking
  - 🔵 low [JANUS-2026-027](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/blob/v2026.11.05-2/security/fixes/JANUS-2026-027.json) - A cluster pull kept an unbounded export in memory, and the site hit GitHub for every unknown version
  - 🔵 low [JANUS-2026-028](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/blob/v2026.11.05-2/security/fixes/JANUS-2026-028.json) - A state import could install an haproxy.cfg that bypassed the global policy
  - 🔵 low [JANUS-2026-030](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/blob/v2026.11.05-2/security/fixes/JANUS-2026-030.json) - A rescue volume's `firewall: skip` left the node without its firewall for the whole boot
  - 🔵 low [JANUS-2026-022](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/blob/v2026.11.05-2/security/fixes/JANUS-2026-022.json) - A release or pre-release could be published from any branch
- **Janus Controller itself** (the Controller), its own code:
  - 🟡 medium [JANUS-2026-021](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/blob/v2026.11.05-2/security/fixes/JANUS-2026-021.json) - The hypervisor SSH key and Proxmox token were stored in clear in the Controller's data directory
  - 🟡 medium [JANUS-2026-024](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/blob/v2026.11.05-2/security/fixes/JANUS-2026-024.json) - An unauthenticated client could fill the SSO pending-sign-in table and block sign-ins
  - 🟡 medium [JANUS-2026-026](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/blob/v2026.11.05-2/security/fixes/JANUS-2026-026.json) - A write-only secret followed a changed URL or TLS trust to a server of the admin's choice
  - 🔵 low [JANUS-2026-020](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/blob/v2026.11.05-2/security/fixes/JANUS-2026-020.json) - Sessions and certificates could outlive a deleted, disabled or demoted account
- **janusctl and the Terraform provider itself** (janusctl and the Terraform provider), its own code:
  - 🟡 medium [JANUS-2026-025](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/blob/v2026.11.05-2/security/fixes/JANUS-2026-025.json) - The janusctl plugin hook missed commands built from variables and under-rated a few effects

## 🧰 Nodes

- **The pairing and rescue window is rate-limited per source** ([JANUS-2026-029](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/blob/v2026.11.05-2/security/fixes/JANUS-2026-029.json)): wrong codes are counted by address, so five from one place pause only that place - the window stays open for everyone else - and a paused source can no longer flood the audit.
- **A rescue volume's `firewall: skip` ends with the window** ([JANUS-2026-030](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/blob/v2026.11.05-2/security/fixes/JANUS-2026-030.json)): the saved ruleset goes back once the window closes, not at the next boot.
- **A connectivity probe can't be crashed** ([JANUS-2026-019](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/blob/v2026.11.05-2/security/fixes/JANUS-2026-019.json)): the raw ICMP socket filters the replies it reads, the header is bounds-checked, and a panic in any RPC is recovered.
- **Fewer ways for a reader to see secrets** ([JANUS-2026-023](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/blob/v2026.11.05-2/security/fixes/JANUS-2026-023.json)): the probe event hides the target's credentials, the config masking covers `tcp-check send` and bearer/cookie/url-param ACLs, the kernel log stays admin-only, and a previous-boot tail is capped.
- **A state import is checked against the global policy** ([JANUS-2026-028](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/blob/v2026.11.05-2/security/fixes/JANUS-2026-028.json)) before it is staged, and a cluster pull is capped so a member can't exhaust memory or install a truncated file ([JANUS-2026-027](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/blob/v2026.11.05-2/security/fixes/JANUS-2026-027.json)).

## 🖥️ Controller

- **The hypervisor SSH key and Proxmox token are sealed on disk** ([JANUS-2026-021](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/blob/v2026.11.05-2/security/fixes/JANUS-2026-021.json)) with the master key, like every other Controller secret; a key written in clear before this release is re-sealed when it is loaded.
- **A deleted, disabled or demoted account loses its sessions and tokens at once** ([JANUS-2026-020](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/blob/v2026.11.05-2/security/fixes/JANUS-2026-020.json)).
- **A flood can't block SSO sign-in** ([JANUS-2026-024](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/blob/v2026.11.05-2/security/fixes/JANUS-2026-024.json)): the pending-sign-in table evicts its oldest entry instead of refusing.
- **A write-only secret stays with its server** ([JANUS-2026-026](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/blob/v2026.11.05-2/security/fixes/JANUS-2026-026.json)): a log target, a RouterOS password, an ACME DNS provider, the Consul token and the SSO client secret are re-required when the destination or the TLS trust changes.

## 🔧 Build and tooling

- **A release can only be cut from `main`** ([JANUS-2026-022](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/blob/v2026.11.05-2/security/fixes/JANUS-2026-022.json)), a maintenance release from a `release/*` branch - never from an arbitrary ref.
- **The janusctl plugin sees a command in a variable** and rates `network vrrp/bgp apply`, `haproxy server-state`/`session-kill` and `login -kit` as critical ([JANUS-2026-025](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/blob/v2026.11.05-2/security/fixes/JANUS-2026-025.json)).
